title: Rational observation from full inputs
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $f$ be a Boolean function on $n$ coordinates, let $J$ be a finite subset of those coordinates, and let $S\subseteq J$. For full sign vectors $z,y,y'\in\{\pm1\}^n$, split each into its outside-$J$ and inside-$J$ parts, denoting these by $z_0,y_0,y'_0$ and $z_1,y_1,y'_1$, respectively. The rational observation is the rational restricted Fourier weight observation at $J,S,z_0,y_1,y'_1$, with the two output signs given by $f$ evaluated at the combined inputs $(y_1,z_0)$ and $(y'_1,z_0)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ coordinates
$J$ is a finite subset of the $n$ coordinates
$z,y,y'$ are full sign vectors on the $n$ coordinates
caveat: The definitions of the coordinate split, combined input, lifted frequency, and rational restricted Fourier weight observation are absent from the payload.
